messages:
jordan_p: Heads-up — async preflight for tonight's bake window (23:00 UTC). Rolling out ff:adaptive-cache to 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~45m. What I did: validated canary image, ran load smoke, updated rollout config. Blockers: CI flagged a KV eviction unit test (non-blocking for traffic) — patch in progress. Today: cut first 10% slice at 23:00, watch p95 and errors, ready to rollback. /cc @sam_sre @tess_prod

tess_prod: Thanks Jordan. If infra needs a bit more time we can delay the first slice +10m. Also product requests experiment tag `experiment=bake-window-2026` on the rollout so analytics can split traffic.

sam_sre: I'll be on pager and watching infra metrics. If p95 > 350ms or 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m I'll trigger fallback to model-variant `small-v2`. I added a temporary alert `rollout.high_latency`.

mike_eng: FYI CI failure is from kv eviction TTL interplay in cache layer. Quick fix in PR #2345 with repro steps. Not blocking canary but prefer to merge before 50% slice.

anya_research: Quick note — adaptive-cache will slightly change embedding latency tail. I'll run a short eval after the 10% slice and drop results into #eng-ml.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: canary-ff-adaptive-cache at 2026-04-10T23:00:00Z. Command: `./deploy rollout --flag adaptive-cache --slices 10,50,100 --pause 15m`

sam_sre: Ops request — keep `log-level` = info. Don't enable debug cluster-wide unless necessary. If you need extra logs, tag entries with `bake=1` so we can filter.

jordan_p: Ack. I'll set the `experiment` tag and hold +10m if infra requests. Action items: @tess_prod confirm tag (done?), @mike_eng merge PR or call blocker, @anya_research post eval link after 10% slice.

tess_prod: Confirmed — `experiment=bake-window-2026` added to rollout metadata. I'll watch user KPIs and signal if anything odd.

mike_eng: PR merged into canary branch, CI reran green at 2056789075.

anya_research: Eval posted https://internal/ev/1234 — topline: ~0.3% latency regress at 95th for embeddings, no metric signal change on quality. Charts attached there.

sam_sre: Copying rollback runbook snippet here for quick reference:

```
# rollback steps
1. toggle ff:adaptive-cache -> off
2. route set model=small-v2
3. pause traffic for 10m
4. notify #eng-oncall and #product
```

jordan_p: Thanks everyone. I'll post a short status update after the 23:45 bake window check. :thumbsup:
